reviewItems.title: Basic credentials for /token can follow a redirect off the root
No time bound on a stalled server, and discovery's attempt timeout is undefined
The exact http allowance does not cover what --usehttp does today, and "under a base" is undefined
The split's test assignment does not match the sections each child builds
Validation and limits the generated layer cannot see are not specified
Candidates walks every discovery result with no cap
The live test asserts on data, not structure
Licensing of the copied spec files and of anything taken from rearm-client-go is not stated
Module dependencies and versioning are not stated accurately
A token request made through Generated() cannot carry Basic credentials
